parameters.query: SELECT (r.tool_id IS NOT NULL) AS found, r.readback_supported, r.accepted_methods, r.evidence_limitation FROM (SELECT 1) AS eins LEFT JOIN jarvis_ops.tool_registry r ON r.tool_id = $1 AND r.version = $2
